sources.conditions: -40..125 C. Transition test: 200 ohm/15 pF, signal=VDD, SEL edges<5 ns, output first 10% change. Supply-off test: source3.6 V, 1 us fall, 200 ohm/15 pF; measured from1.5 V supply crossing to90% output. Add external discharge; neither number establishes OE low.
sources.gap: Signal voltage allowance below1.5 V does not provide an arbitrary dwell/bounce leakage or OFF-transition bound. Zero-supply Ipoff is not a full brownout proof. At3.6V request, the normal signal range additionally requires VDD>=1.8V; 1.5..1.8V is not covered for that signal.

sources.conditions: Disable column: VCCA3.3+/-0.3 V, VCCB5+/-0.5 V,-40..125 C. Output load5 pF/10k; generator<=1 ns/V. OE current tested at supply or ground; capacitance at equal3.3 V supplies.
sources.gap: RC OE edge and actual output load require timing applicability; 0.8 V is an allocated target, not a universal brownout threshold. TXU documents glitch-free supply sequencing, but that does not qualify invalid upstream permission.

sources.disposition: Rejected as a substitute for this signal-isolation boundary: fail-safe SEL is separate from signal power-off protection; recommended signal range is0..VDD. No broad alternative search performed.
